1.why: The interface uses a clean bold sans-serif with clear label/field separation and comfortable line spacing across all four screens.

2.why: All copy is short sentence-case lines with no italics, no all-caps, and no dense paragraphs anywhere in the flow.

3.why: Content sits in a narrow centred card that would plausibly reflow on a phone, but the only evidence provided is desktop-width captures, so mobile layout is unverified.

4.why: Instructions such as 'Sign in to begin. Take your time.' and 'Enter the same contact details again.' are one short plain-language line each.

5.why: Every field shows a format placeholder (name@example.com, 07123 456789) plus explicit 'Demo:' example values beneath it.

6.why: No screen contains more than a heading, one short instruction line, field hints and a tip box, so no long text must be read to proceed.

7.why: The flow halts at step 2 with an error and never reaches any secret, OTP key, or recovery codes, so no copy-to-clipboard control is present in any screenshot.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent alternative to manual entry appears; the authenticator provisioning screen never renders.

9.why: Standard email/phone/password inputs are used, but there is no visible autofill assistance or evidence of autocomplete/password-manager support, and enrolment never proceeds.

10.why: A 'Step 2 of 6 · Confirm identity' label with progress bar sits at top and the single dark-blue filled button is the visually dominant action.

11.why: Each screen asks for one thing only — sign in, or confirm identity — with a single primary button.

12.why: Step 2 confirmed plainly ('You are signed in. Next, confirm your identity.'), but the next action returns only 'Invalid array length' with no statement of what happened or what comes next.

13.why: Retry of the contact details is possible and stated, but the reveal/hide/re-request of codes is unreachable because the flow is blocked at step 2.

14.why: The error shown is the raw technical exception 'Invalid array length', which names neither the problem in user terms nor any fix.

15.why: The screens explicitly say 'No reading timer. You can retry any step.' and 'Take your time.', and no countdown or auto-expiry element is visible.
